title: Sogni World (world.json)
description: A finished, playable world. `node world build` writes it; the player reads it. Media paths are relative to this file, or absolute https URLs.

credit.description: Shown in the About panel, e.g. who made it and how.

aspect.description: The shape every place is shown at (the stills' and films' width and height).

start.description: The id of the first place.

order.description: A story told in order: the place ids in sequence. The player offers each place's next stop first and marks the rest as shortcuts. null for a free-roaming world.

underFilms.description: Multiplier while a film or narration plays.

speakers.description: Optional avatars for narration speakers, keyed by the name used in narration lines.

intro.description: The Begin card's words. Every field is optional; the defaults suit a photo world.

eyebrow.description: Small line above the title (default "A Sogni World").

tagline.description: A line or two under the title.

warning.description: A content note on the card, e.g. for an 18+ world.

map.description: false hides the Places panel (a world with secrets or fatal choices). Default true.

draft.description: true when the build used takes nobody has approved yet (`node world build --drafts`); the player says so.

src720.description: An exact half-size copy for phones and slow connections.

still.description: The canonical still. Every film that starts or ends here starts or ends on exactly this picture.

loop.description: The living photograph: plays over the still, starting and ending on it.

src.description: Optional audio; without it the lines show at reading pace.

ending.description: This place ends the story: a death (Rewind chooses again) or an ending. The player shows its card on arrival.

hotspot.description: Every hotspot has a film, except a collectible with a figure, which may be picked up straight from the picture.

label.description: What happens when you click, as an action: "Duck through the round door".

at.description: Where the label sits, as fractions of the picture's width and height.

outline.description: The object's traced SAM 3 outline: an SVG path in a width × height coordinate space that covers the whole picture.

to.description: The place this crossing lands on; null for a moment that returns here.

next.description: In a story told in order, this is the way to the next stop.

shortcut.description: A crossing that jumps out of the story's order, offered as an easter egg.

collect.description: A collectible: its moment plays (or, with a figure and no film, it is picked up straight away), then it joins the visitor's collection (kept in their browser). Never has "to".

figure.description: A collectible's 3D figure (Pixal3D GLB): after its moment the visitor turns it over, and it appears in their collection.

icon.description: The object cut out on transparency (PNG): its picture in the collection.

name.description: What it is called in the collection.

rewind.description: The film reversed, played by Back.
